description.value:
Made from fermented legume-based products. It smells sour and pungent, but tastes cool and refreshing.
If you can drink a big bottle of mung bean soda and remain calm, you will definitely impress the gormandizers on the Luofu.

"Like mung beans? Like soda? Then what are you complaining about!?"

D&D 5e Effect

As an action, consume this item and choose the creatures in your Main Party who can see you. The benefit begins when the next combat starts and lasts for 1 minute. For each affected creature, Strength increases by 1, maximum 20. A creature can benefit from only one synthesized pre-combat consumable at a time; a new one replaces the previous one.

GM Description — Original HSR Effect

Upon use, increases ATK of all allies by 5% plus an additional 170 ATK increase for the next battle.
